query: SELECT r.id, r.name, r.url, r.category, r.language, r.isActive, r.lastFetchedAt, COUNT(n.id) as newsCount FROM rssSources r LEFT JOIN news n ON n.source = r.name GROUP BY r.id ORDER BY r.language, r.isActive DESC;
